class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right

def singlevalued(root):
    def count_single_valued(node):
        if node is None:
            return 0, True
        
        left_count, is_left_single = count_single_valued(node.left)
        right_count, is_right_single = count_single_valued(node.right)
        
        total_count = left_count + right_count
        
        if (is_left_single and (node.left is None or node.left.val == node.val)) and \
           (is_right_single and (node.right is None or node.right.val == node.val)):
            return total_count + 1, True
        else:
            return total_count, False
    
    _, result = count_single_valued(root)
    return result
